text:
devon: Hey team — quick design review for the routing rule sequencer controls in the policies editor. Screenshot attached: https://img.redwood.internal/seq-toolbar-v3.png :eyes:

devon: Key asks: 1) Does the new drag-handle + keyboard sort affordance feel discoverable? 2) Are validation messages clear when two rules overlap? 3) Any a11y gaps (focus, screen reader labels) before we ship the preview sim?

maria: +1 on the direction. Copy tweak request: instead of \"Conflicting rules detected\" can we try \"Overlapping rules may change routing\" — less alarmist and suggests action. Also add a short hint: \"Review preview to confirm final behavior.\"

ashok: Re: keyboard sorting — current impl moves the focused rule with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, but focus doesn't follow the item after reorder. Proposed handler snippet:

```js
function onKey(e, idx) {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') swap(idx, idx+1);
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') swap(idx, idx-1);
  // ensure focus remains on the moved item
  requestAnimationFrame(() => items[idx +/- 1].focus());
}
```

ashok: downside: requestAnimationFrame focus hack can be flaky with virtualization. If we switch to index-based focus management in state it's more stable.

kevin: From DS perspective, add aria-grabbed on the handle and role=\"list\"/\"listitem\" semantics. For the preview button, aria-expanded should reflect the sim drawer state. Also ensure the drag handle has an accessible name: \"Move rule: <rule name>\".

aria: QA notes / test checklist:
- Keyboard: tab to rule, use Space to pick up, Arrow keys to reorder, Enter to drop. Focus should stay visible.
- SR: NVDA/VoiceOver should announce \"picked up\" and \"dropped\" with rule index.
- Validation: overlapping rule toast must include which rule IDs and a CTA to open the preview.
- Preview sim: test with cached model variants — preview must show live routing path, not cached state.

devon: Love the copy suggestion, @maria — can we update the UX copy table?

maria: Sure, here's a minimal set I propose:
- Conflict header: \"Overlapping rules may change routing\"
- Conflict body: \"Two rules match the same request. Use the sequencer or preview to confirm which rule wins.\"
- Preview CTA: \"Open preview\" (primary) / \"Ignore\" (tertiary)

kevin: Also add an aria-live region for validation messages (polite), so screen readers pick them up without interrupting typing.

ashok: Implementation note: validation runs on save + in real-time when changes are made. Real-time validation should debounce 300ms. If we surface the message live, don't block keyboard reordering.

devon: UX question — animation when reordering: subtle slide is fine but screen readers should not get noisy. We should disable motion for prefers-reduced-motion.

kevin: add prefers-reduced-motion check and reduce animation time to 0 for that preference.

aria: Edge case caught in test: when rules are auto-prioritized by import, focus lands on the top rule but preview does not auto-open. Suggest a tiny toast: \"Rules reordered on import — open preview? [Open preview]\"

preview-bot: Generated preview snapshot for thread 1769954321: https://preview.redwood.internal/snapshots/1769954321-1.png

devon: Thanks all — I'll update the Figma with the copy changes, add aria props to the component spec, and create a small RFC for index-based focus management. Leaving this open for 24h for any last comments. :wave:
